b: Important Information About Procedures for Opening a New Account

runs: To help the government fight the funding of terrorism and money laundering activities, federal law requires all financial institutions to obtain, verify, and record information that identifies each person who opens an account.

What this means for you: when you register for a debit card linked to your account, we will ask for your name, address, date of birth, and other information that will allow us to identify you. We may also ask to see your driver's license or other identifying documents.
The debit card is issued by Cross River Bank, with X Payments LLC acting as Program Manager.
